description: Which known vulnerabilities in this project's dependencies does its own code actually pull in? Returns security cards ranked by exposure (imported by first-party code first; a package only sitting in the lockfile is context, not a finding), then severity, then direct before transitive. Each finding names the advisory and its aliases, the package@version, the fixed versions, and the importing files and lines to change. Says where the advisories came from and how fresh they are.

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

service.description: Only this service (its name or service: node id). Omit for the whole project.

name: get_reachable_cves
